name: self-help
description: Azure SelfHelp will help you troubleshoot issues with Azure resources

subcommands.name: check-name-availability
subcommands.description: This API is used to check the uniqueness of a resource name used for a diagnostic check

options.name: --scope
options.description: This is an extension resource provider and only resource level extension is supported at the moment

options.name: --name
options.description: The name of the resource for which availability needs to be checked

options.name: --type
options.description: The resource type

subcommands.name: diagnostic
subcommands.description: Diagnostic command will help you create diagnostics for azure resources

subcommands.name: create
subcommands.description: Creates a diagnostics that will help you troubleshoot an issue with your azure resource

options.name: --diagnostic-name
options.description: Unique resource name for diagnostic proxy resources

options.name: --scope
options.description: This is an extension resource provider and only resource level extension is supported at the moment

options.name: --global-parameters
options.description: Global parameters that can be passed to all solutionIds. Support shorthand-syntax, json-file and yaml-file. Try "??" to show more

options.name: --insights
options.description: SolutionIds that are needed to be invoked. Support shorthand-syntax, json-file and yaml-file. Try "??" to show more

options.name: --no-wait
options.description: Do not wait for the long-running operation to finish

subcommands.name: show
subcommands.description: Get the diagnostics using the 'diagnosticsResourceName' you chose while creating the diagnostic

options.name: --diagnostic-name
options.description: Unique resource name for diagnostic proxy resources

options.name: --scope
options.description: This is an extension resource provider and only resource level extension is supported at the moment

subcommands.name: wait
subcommands.description: Place the CLI in a waiting state until a condition is met

options.name: --diagnostic-name
options.description: Unique resource name for diagnostic proxy resources

options.name: --scope
options.description: This is an extension resource provider and only resource level extension is supported at the moment

options.name: --created
options.description: Wait until created with 'provisioningState' at 'Succeeded'

options.name: --custom
options.description: Wait until the condition satisfies a custom JMESPath query. E.g. provisioningState!='InProgress', instanceView.statuses[?code=='PowerState/running']

options.name: --deleted
options.description: Wait until deleted

options.name: --exists
options.description: Wait until the resource exists

options.name: --interval
options.description: Polling interval in seconds

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Maximum wait in seconds

options.name: --updated
options.description: Wait until updated with provisioningState at 'Succeeded'

subcommands.name: discovery-solution
subcommands.description: Discovery-solution command will help you discover available solutions based on your resource type and problem classification Id

subcommands.name: list
subcommands.description: List the existing available solutions for the problemClassificationId or the resourceUri for the Azure resource

options.name: --scope
options.description: This is an extension resource provider and only resource level extension is supported at the moment

options.name: --filter
options.description: Can be used to filter solutionIds by 'ProblemClassificationId'. The filter supports only 'and' and 'eq' operators.

options.name: --skiptoken
options.description: Skiptoken is only used if a previous operation returned a partial result.
